name: Machine Kneeling Torso Rotation
steps: Set the swivel pad to one side and kneel in the middle of the platform.
Hold the fixed handles and brace your chest against the support so your upper body faces forward.
Rotate your hips and lower body smoothly against the resistance by contracting your obliques until you reach a full controlled twist.
Return slowly to the starting angle without letting the stack bang, and switch the machine setting to repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Drive the twist from your obliques rather than yanking yourself around with your arms.
Keep your spine tall and move within a comfortable, controlled range of rotation.
